template<typename P>
inline uint4 ld4(P p) { return uint4(p[0], p[1], p[2], p[3]); }
idea: Each lane loads 32 weights per row as one 16-byte uint4 for 4 rows, all loads issued before any math, so there are half as many loop trips and more bytes in flight per lane than k001; masked nibbles against 16^-i pre-scaled x still avoid shifts.
